children: Overview
France pharmaceutical firm's H1 net income turned positive, reversing prior yr loss
Revenue from ordinary activities grew 13% yr/yr, driven by Sibnayal and Likozam sales
Company withdrew U.S. marketing application for ADV7103, citing need for additional CMC work
Outlook
Advicenne expects continued strong sales growth in Europe and the Middle East in H2 2026
Company anticipates a significant reduction in operating expenses in H2 2026
Advicenne sees conclusion of safeguard observation period in November 2026 as a key milestone
Result Drivers
FRANCE SALES GROWTH - Co said accelerating volume growth for Sibnayal and Likozam in France, following pricing agreements, drove product sales
ROYALTY INCREASE - Co said royalties from Sibnayal distributors in Europe and Middle East rose 45%, contributing to revenue growth
NON-RECURRING ITEMS - Operating income benefited from reversal of provision and compensation for Likozam early access rebates after pricing agreements
